content:
Priya K: Draft for the release notes is in the relnotes branch. Need: three short feature bullets, a Known Issues paragraph, and confirmation that the SDK snippets for Py/JS/Go still match the public API. Also flag any copy that needs localization.

tom: I'll run the JS and Go snippets today. Quick check: the newest runtime dropped the `max_tokens` default in favor of `max_output_tokens` 12 so some examples might need updating.

oliver: Thanks. I noticed the CLI example uses `--stream` flag but our SDK now streams by default in hosted mode; suggest we either make the flag explicit or add a short note.

Priya K: Let's add a one-line dev note in the examples: "Note: hosted API streams by default; set stream:false for non-streaming" and call it out in the changelog.

l10n-bot: Reminder: any string changes under /docs/content/relnotes/ must have i18n keys bumped. Please list keys you change in the PR description.

tom: Ran snippets locally. Py + JS work after swapping `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens`. Go example needs small rename in the response struct. I'll open a PR with patches.

oliver: I updated the CLI note and added a short Known Issues paragraph: "Cold cache requests may incur an extra ~1s latency on first token generation. Embedding score distributions shifted slightly after tokenizer update; rebaseline thresholds if you rely on hard cutoffs."

Priya K: Good. Add ops-requested note about regional fallback: "If primary region is saturated, requests will fallback to the nearest compatible region which may increase latency." Put that in Known Issues too.

build-bot: Preview build available: https://preview.redwood/relnotes/3298374621 13 (build #27).

tom: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4477 14 14 contains snippet updates and a changelog callout. Included a checklist for l10n keys.

oliver: I pushed a tiny wording tweak to the feature bullet about caching; made it clearer for engineers who are monitoring token-level latency.

Priya K: Plan: merge all docs PRs by tomorrow 10am PT, wait for one final l10n pass, then publish. If localization blocks, we'll mark the relnotes as English-only for the immediate publish and schedule localized updates next week. Thanks team!
